name: tvos
description: Home screen rápida e sem anúncios para a TV LG 43UP7500PSF (webOS TV 6.x)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node scripts/check-encoding.mjs
scripts.tv:package: npm run build && ares-package dist/app dist/service -o dist
scripts.tv:install: npm run tv:package && ares-install -d tv dist/com.lurickardo.tvos_0.1.0_all.ipk && ares-launch -d tv com.lurickardo.tvos
